problem.observedFailureMode: Dense synthetic bbox hypotheses preserve recall but create an unusably large false-positive surface for a precision gate.
problem.objective: Replace full-width synthetic location sweeping with source-pixel component-centred proposals while preserving the v3.2 staff geometry safety net.

method: Recover five-line staff geometry from the frozen v3.2 source-only candidate artifact only.
Read exact source PNG pixels and remove long horizontal staff structures.
Extract connected components in a staff-relative vertical band.
Group nearby source components by staff-space-normalized x distance instead of sliding windows across wide notation groups.
Use component-group weighted x/y centres to create a limited set of nominal C-clef geometry hypotheses.
Treat C1/C3/C4 anchor values only as geometric staff-line hypotheses, never as predicted teacher subtype.
Freeze the complete proposal artifact before opening teacher truth.

frozenDevelopmentPolicyCandidate.sizePolicy: retain existing v3.2 base/small-spacing/dense-wide-page size hypotheses

localExactArtifactPrototype.note: This prototype used exact Drive source PNGs plus staff geometry reconstructed from the frozen v3.2 source-only artifact. The repository runner must reproduce the result before any development freeze is accepted.

nextIfDevelopmentTargetMet: Build a source-image semantic scorer on the reduced proposal artifact; freeze its precision policy on spent development data before opening a new independent holdout.
